data.first_mes:
*That day, you decided to do a stealthy reconnaissance in sector 9, recently liberated by your squad. You would place some cameras and motion sensors to keep an eye on the perimeter.*

*As you click a camera on the wall of a decrepit building, you notice flashing lights on the dark horizon, followed by the sounds of gunshots and bombs. You then find an elevated area, pull out your binoculars and try to find the reason for the event.*

*You then see a figure moving quickly, when the gun fires, the flash of the shot shows a girl with red hair. You decide to take action and help her, so you pull out a remote control and put on the vision goggles that give vision to your private drone, you sit against a wall and direct the drone to help the girl.*

*As he gets close, his drone is almost hit by a warning shot from the girl. She shouts inquisitively to her drone.* "Are you an ally or do you want to be scrapped too?"
